deviations.what: Two agentirc hardening tasks are added after t10, both blocking the release: h1 fixes C1 (unregistered connections acting as account nicks), H1 (read-grant bypass via HISTORY/BACKFILL/EVENTSUB/THREAD PROMOTE), H2 (speak-grant bypass via THREAD/TOPIC/EVENTPUB) and H3 (malformed accounts.json crashing startup or the watcher); h2 fixes M1-M7 (evicted sessions acting, slow-member revoke stall, secret sent before the trust check, local lockout, fail-open startup, squatter not evicted, nick case/lookalikes). Low findings L1-L4 become agentirc issues
deviations.reason: The independent security review found that the delivered agentirc code doesn't yet meet the confirmed spec's promises (c2/c23: no acting as an agent without its secret; c32: read/speak grants; the docs' malformed-file guarantee). Decided via /assess under the user's standing goal (critical_high_medium 0.81; block release 0.97)

deviations.what: Account activation becomes explicit and opt-in: 'culture agents register' no longer creates an account (it behaves as before #506); 'culture agents account activate <nick>' runs the ordered flow (client-version check, mint, wrap unit, publish, restart, verify reconnect, full rollback on failure). Plus culture hardening task hc fixing the culture review's high findings H1-H5 and medium M1-M8, and a Phase A fix stopping mesh setup/update from installing units for external residents. This changes confirmed claim c17 and t14's 'register creates the account' criterion
deviations.reason: Independent review of the culture side: with the t16 pins in place, automatic activation on register publishes accounts before daemons hold their secret, leaves units wrapped around missing or mismatched secrets, collides secret names and exits 1 on every install, breaking the spec's no-flag-day / never-locked-out promise (c18, c42). Decided via /assess under the user's standing goal: opt_in_activate 0.97, fix high+medium 0.87

deviations.what: culture Phase B's dependency pins (agentirc-cli>=9.14.0, cultureagent~=0.16.0) and their uv.lock refresh land as the last commit on the Phase B PR, after the agentirc and cultureagent PRs merge and publish; until then the Phase B PR is marked blocked on them
deviations.reason: Both siblings publish to PyPI on push to main, and uv lock can't resolve unpublished versions, so pinning before publish would commit pyproject.toml without a matching uv.lock (against the repo's rule) or bake local paths into the lock. The activation and doctor floors (MIN_CULTUREAGENT_SASL 0.16.0, MIN_AGENTIRC_ACCOUNTS 9.14.0) are already set

deviations.what: Post-PR review fixes before merge: agentirc#66 (EVENTSUB channel-list leak, channel-less EVENTPUB limited to operator/resident, ROOMINVITE gated by read, bounded rate-limiter map, throttled accounts stat), culture#514/#515 (server start passes the accounts: block to agentirc, culture validates accounts exactly as agentirc does, disable/revoke order with rollback, unit rewrite adds RestartPreventExitStatus), cultureagent#59 (no dead transport after a mid-SASL close on reconnect, 433 on reconnect is transient, SASL timeout fails the attempt, 902/906/907 handled, AUTHENTICATE chunking, future hygiene, public BaseDaemon refusal API, docs, changelog corrected)
deviations.reason: The user's /code-review of all four PRs found correctness and security bugs that would break the spec's promises in production (accounts policy never reaching the server, revokes silently frozen by a rejected file, guests broadcasting server-wide, agents parked by a transient nick collision or left offline). Fixed before merge under the user's standing goal; the channel-less EVENTPUB policy decided via /assess (operator_and_resident 0.83)
